title: Impact of Structured Digital Preoperative Assessment Support on the Completeness and Quality of the Preoperative Anesthesia Consultation
summary:
Before surgery, the patient has a consultation with the treating anesthesiologist. During this consultation, existing medical conditions, regularly taken medications, allergies and potential risks associated with the planned anesthesia are assessed. This information is important to ensure safe preparation for anesthesia and to make any necessary adjustments to medication management. As many different aspects need to be considered, incomplete information or errors in documentation and medication planning may occur in everyday clinical practice.

This study investigates whether a digital decision-support tool can help improve the completeness and quality of documentation during this consultation and reduce errors in medication planning. The digital tool compiles information already available about the patients and presents relevant data and recommendations in a clear and structured manner. Medical decisions remain entirely the responsibility of the treating anesthesiologist.

For this purpose, approximately 200–300 records of preoperative anesthesia consultations from before and 200–300 records from after the introduction of the digital decision-support tool will be evaluated. The completeness of documentation, consideration of relevant health risks, medication planning and the time required for the consultation will be compared.

The evaluation will be conducted using a specifically developed data collection form, which is used to systematically assess the completeness and accuracy of the information documented in the digital preoperative anesthesia records. No additional examinations or patient interviews will be performed.
conditions: Assessment of the documentation of pre-existing medical conditions and health problems relevant to preoperative anesthesia care, particularly cardiovascular, pulmonary and metabolic diseases, as well as other comorbidities relevant to anesthesia.

interventions.name:
Arm1: Pre-Group (Control Group)
Preoperative anesthesia assessment without the use of a digital decision-support tool (standard care).

Arm2: Post-Group (Intervention Group)
Preoperative anesthesia assessment with the use of a digital decision-support tool for the structured presentation of preoperative assessment-related information.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Inpatient admission for elective surgery; completion of a full preoperative anesthesia assessment; documentation of the preoperative anesthesia assessment in the digital hospital information system within the study period from 23/11/2026 to 01/09/2027.
Exclusion criteria:
Emergency or unplanned surgical procedures; age under 18 years; incomplete or discontinued preoperative anesthesia assessment; documentation outside the defined study periods (pre- and post-phase).
